invalid_reasons: The flag was enabled during Standing_Preparation, changing 144 first-policy self-observation values and all 69 first-policy output actions before the intended intervention.

Standing states bypass ApplyRuntimeControlTuning and republish control authority through PublishStandingPhysicsControlState. The experimental physics evidence therefore showed MaxTorqueMultiplier=1.0, identical to control, so no torque intervention occurred.

conclusion.learned: The authoritative standing-control setter is PublishStandingPhysicsControlState, not ApplyRuntimeControlTuning. The fresh intervention must remain at multiplier 1.0 through the first active-standing input/action capture and publish 10.0 only on subsequent standing-control updates.
